title: Context Slice Engine v2 — Slice
description: Canonical payload for a materialized Context Slice. Content-addressed derived cache: slice_hash is sha256 over the canonical payload excluding the audit envelope. The audit envelope is a sibling property bag populated by the persistence layer and is NEVER part of the hashed payload. Timestamps and durations live ONLY inside audit; canonical payload properties are clock-free. Persisted complete relative to the indexed graph (Locked decision #6); token/node/edge budgets apply only at the Pack layer.

slice_hash.description: sha256 over the canonical payload (audit envelope excluded).

derivation_key.description: sha256 over the full derivation key struct: normalized seeds, traversal policy and version, accepted-baseline hashes, system/journey hashes, engine/schema versions, and materialization options (Locked decision #4).

id_version.description: Layered identity version (ADR 0009). Every v2 Slice carries id_version=2. Participates in derivation_key and slice_hash so a version bump invalidates all downstream identities.

engine_version.description: Materializer engine version. Equal derivation keys MUST produce equal engine_version.

slice_schema_version.description: Version of this schema used to produce the payload. ADR 0009: integer (v2=2), consistent with explorer_schema_versions.version INTEGER and buildDerivationInputs().

system_namespace.description: Knowledge Namespace of the project the Slice was materialized for.

policy.description: Traversal policy name, version, and options hash. options_hash participates in derivation_key.

seeds.description: Normalized seeds used to bootstrap materialization. Order is producer-canonical.

l0_baselines.description: Accepted L0 baselines referenced by the Slice. Each baseline's canonical_graph_hash participates in derivation_key.

l1.description: L1 edge set used by the Slice. L1 is cross-repo only (Locked decision #9).

l2_bindings.description: L2 JourneySpec bindings referenced. journey_hash participates in derivation_key.

nodes.description: Nodes in the materialized subgraph, canonical order.

edges.description: Edges in the materialized subgraph, canonical order.

misses.description: Explicit misses: missing indexing, unresolved dispatch, uncertain links, policy boundaries (Locked decision #11).

coverage.description: Indexed-vs-visited coverage counters. Completeness is relative to the indexed graph.

provenance.description: Structural provenance summary (seed-set hash and counts). No clock fields.

audit.description: Telemetry envelope populated by the persistence layer. OPTIONAL and NEVER part of the canonical payload that is hashed.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex-encoded SHA-256 digest (64 chars). Matches skills/explorer-l0/src/stable-json.mjs sha256Text output.

sliceId.description: Stable Slice identifier: literal prefix 'slice:' + slice_hash.

canonicalId.description: Type-prefixed Canonical ID, same shape as explorer-l0 contracts/relation.schema.json canonicalRecordId.

policyName.description: Closed policy enum. journey: forward-oriented traversal. impact: upstream + downstream + cross-service + data deps. drill-down: explicit relationship allowlist (Locked decision #10).

missReason.description: Closed miss-reason enum (Locked decision #11). index_missing: target not yet indexed; the others describe traversal-time gaps against an indexed graph.

layerTag.description: Layer a node/edge originates from. l0 is intra-repo, l1 is cross-repo, l2 is journey bindings.

options_hash.description: sha256 over normalized materialization options. Participates in derivation_key.

candidate_id.description: Baseline candidate id that became accepted via Human Gate.

edge_set_hash.description: Deterministic hash over the accepted L1 edge set used.

bind_id.description: Optional resolved bind identifier for the journey.

target_id.description: Canonical ID of the target the Slice failed to resolve.

detail.description: Human-readable miss context. No machine paths, secrets, or raw payloads.

seed_set_hash.description: sha256 over the canonical normalized seed set used by the materializer.

baseline_count.description: Number of accepted L0 baselines referenced.

edge_count.description: Number of L1 edges referenced, if any.

audit.description: Persistence-layer telemetry envelope. NEVER part of the canonical hashed payload; populated only when the Slice is stored or reused.

updated_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp at last cache hit / refresh.

relation_id.description: Optional relation anchor within the same baseline.
